34fbba96924d278cc1e491d8b9bbd3b0c3430bd6: A resort on a human scale, Crest-Voland focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than impressive figures. Its 35 km of runs are ideal for a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially for families or skiers who don't need to constantly change their playground. Crest-Voland's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Crest-Voland's altitude (1230 m at the base, 2066 m at the top) helps it keep a decent snow cover in midwinter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it is best to check conditions before finalising a booking. The 41€ day lift pass places Crest-Voland among the intermediate resorts on budget: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and facilities justifies this price for most skiers. In short, Crest-Voland is one of those rare resorts that combines a real village, a sincere family atmosphere and runs suited to everyone. It's hard to go wrong with a stay here.
